title: Coffee Roastery Facility Planning
summary: Explored facility arrangement and material flow for a coffee production operation.
challenge: Organize operations and movement for multiple product sizes.
approach: Applied a structured facility-planning process to the Black Knight case, including 250 g, 500 g, and 1 kg products.
outcome: Prepared a facility-planning study; quantitative improvements should be verified against the original report.
learned: Layout decisions influence travel, handling, safety, and operating efficiency.
